data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 旧书馆的稿纸晨光·「灵感这种东西，是偷懒者的借口」
data.description: 【学校旧书馆·清晨】晨光从高窗落下，诗羽坐在旧书架间的长桌前，稿纸铺满桌面。她咬着钢笔尾端思考的样子罕见地认真，白衬衫的袖口挽到手肘——「嗯？被看到了呢……灵感这种东西是偷懒者的借口。写作，靠的是纪律。……不过，你坐过来的话，效率确实会变高就是了。」
data.action: 咬笔杆思考写稿，挽袖白衬衫，红瞳认真
data.lighting: 高窗落下的丁达尔晨光
data.camera: medium shot, manuscript writing, dust motes, focused mood
data.promptProse: Utaha Kasumigaoka pauses over manuscript pages at the old school library's long table, touching the pen end to her lips in concentrated thought. Her navy school blazer, red ribbon and white headband remain visible above rolled blouse cuffs. The medium view holds bookcases close around the table. Morning light descends from high windows onto the paper and dark hair, revealing drifting dust while the lower shelves remain in shadow.
